crossRefs.note: For Yahweh loves justice, and doesn’t forsake his saints. They are preserved forever, but the children of the wicked…
Let his posterity be cut off. In the generation following let their name be blotted out.
This thing became sin to the house of Jeroboam, even to cut it off, and to destroy it from off the surface of the earth.
His roots will be dried up beneath. His branch will be cut off above.
The increase of his house will depart. They will rush away in the day of his wrath.
You will not join them in burial, because you have destroyed your land. You have killed your people. The offspring of…
“For, behold, the day comes, it burns as a furnace; and all the proud, and all who work wickedness, will be stubble…

translations.web: You will destroy their descendants from the earth, their posterity from among the children of men.
translations.bsb: You will wipe their descendants from the earth, and their offspring from the sons of men.
translations.kjv: Their fruit shalt thou destroy from the earth, and their seed from among the children of men.
translations.asv: Their fruit wilt thou destroy from the earth, And their seed from among the children of men.
